proposed.title: Unused BigQuery key-file credentials must not block source setup
answers: Why does BigQuery setup list missing JSON fields when I selected a service account?
Can an empty key file from the unselected auth option block saving?
How should BigQuery replace generic required-field errors?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Connecting BigQuery with a selected Google Cloud service account fails with missing JSON key-field errors despite a complete selection.
Root cause: products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/common/config.py:validate_config validates nested key-file fields; the wizard can send an empty key file for the unselected option.
Fix pattern: products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/bigquery/source.py:BigQuerySource.validate_config removes errors identified by _KEY_FILE_FIELD_ERRORS, recomputes validity from remaining errors, and then checks the selected credential. Construct matching errors through products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/common/config.py:missing_field_error so producer and filter share wording.
Constraints: Suppress only the key-file required-field errors, preserving other validation failures and the selected-credential check. Keep this behavior in the BigQuery override; it does not establish a shared-walker policy for other sources.
proposed.applies: BigQuery source configuration validation when payloads include credentials for both authentication options.

proposed.title: Validate the selected BigQuery credential in nested and flat payloads
answers: Why can a BigQuery source save without credentials?
How does BigQuery validate a bare auth_type string?
Can credentials from the other authentication option satisfy validation?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A BigQuery source saves without a usable credential when the authentication choice arrives as a bare string.
Root cause: products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/bigquery/source.py:BigQuerySource.validate_config previously returned before checking credentials for a string auth_type.
Fix pattern: Normalize the selection and credential container before validation: string auth_type uses top-level job_inputs; dictionary auth_type uses its selection and nested fields. Validate the credential required by that selection.
Constraints: Form credential fields are optional because unselected options must not block saving, so the source-level check must remain. Credentials belonging to the unselected option must not satisfy the selected option; cover both shapes in products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/bigquery/tests/test_source.py:test_bigquery_validate_config_requires_the_credential_for_the_selected_auth_type and test_bigquery_validate_config_reads_a_bare_selection_from_the_flat_payload.
proposed.applies: Changes to BigQuery authentication selection parsing or credential validation for nested and flat configuration payloads.

proposed.title: BigQuery key-file completeness requires nonempty values and upload guidance
answers: Why does uploading a JSON file fail BigQuery setup?
How should an incomplete service account key be reported?
Does a present but empty private_key pass validation?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Uploading JSON that is not a complete Google Cloud service account key produces internal field names, or an empty private_key passes validation.
Root cause: products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/common/config.py:validate_config checks field presence; uploaded key fields are not individually editable in the source form.
Fix pattern: In products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/bigquery/source.py:BigQuerySource.validate_config, require truthy values for every field named by _KEY_FILE_FIELD_NAMES, which derives from the key-file config dataclass. Report missing uploads through _MISSING_KEY_FILE_ERROR and partial files through _INCOMPLETE_KEY_FILE_ERROR.
Constraints: Apply these checks when key_file is selected. A non-dictionary or dictionary with no truthy values receives upload guidance; a dictionary with some values but any missing or empty expected field receives complete-key guidance. This is a completeness check, not proof that credentials authenticate successfully.
proposed.applies: Validation and user-facing errors for the selected BigQuery service account JSON key-file option.

proposed.title: Codex ratings must use the trace ID actually stamped on gateway requests
answers: A Slack rating on a Codex answer points at nothing
Codex generations appear in separate traces
How should the agent-server resolve a turn's trace ID?
Can Claude use the run ID as its trace ID?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A Slack rating on a Codex answer cannot open the turn, and each generation appears in a separate trace.
Root cause: Requests lacked a shared trace header and turn results lacked a matching fallback; these concerns are handled by products/desktop/packages/agent/src/server/agent-server.ts:AgentServer.configureEnvironment and AgentServer.turnTraceId.
Fix pattern: Stamp X-PostHog-Trace-Id with the Codex run ID, derive the fallback from the actual configured header, and propagate that same ID through rating-facing results and turn-complete events. Preserve an adapter-reported string trace ID.
Constraints: Stamp only Codex runs with a taskRunId on the authenticated Go gateway path. Without AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN, the Python gateway fallback carries no stamp, so adapter type alone cannot justify a run-ID fallback. Reset the stored fallback on reinitialization. Never stamp Claude: this header outranks traceparent and would collapse its per-turn traces into one run trace.
proposed.applies: Agent-server gateway configuration and trace IDs exposed to Slack ratings or turn-complete consumers.

proposed.title: Enrich ACP turn-complete events before persistence and broadcast
answers: A reloaded agent thread loses the turn's trace ID
Where should missing ACP turn trace IDs be filled in?
How do stored and streamed turn-complete events stay consistent?
proposed.body:
Invariant: In products/desktop/packages/agent/src/adapters/acp-connection.ts:installWireTaps, apply trace enrichment before appendNotification and pass the same enriched message and event ID to onWireMessage.
Reason: Thread reloads read the stored notification; enriching only the broadcast copy leaves reloads without the trace ID needed to open the turn.
Guard: products/desktop/packages/agent/src/acp-extensions.ts:withTurnTraceId fills only turn-complete notifications with object params, a supplied fallback, and no existing string traceId.
Constraints: Preserve adapter-reported string trace IDs, leave other notification kinds unchanged, and supply no fallback when gateway headers did not stamp a trace.
proposed.applies: ACP wire notification enrichment shared by session logs and live agent event consumers.

proposed.title: Measure sync activity without advancing the signals watermark
answers: Why does a quiet warehouse source appear to have stopped syncing?
Which timestamp tells us when a schema last ran?
Can an empty sync advance last_synced_at?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A warehouse source keeps syncing on schedule but is reported as stopped and receives an unnecessary schedule repair.
Root cause: products/warehouse_sources/backend/stalled_schedules.py:stalled_schema_queryset previously measured silence using only last_synced_at, which stays unchanged on zero-row v3 runs.
Fix pattern: Use the later of last_synced_at and the usable last_full_run_at for run activity, as defined by products/warehouse_sources/backend/models/external_data_schema.py:ExternalDataSchema.last_run_at; products/data_warehouse/backend/sync_status.py:_is_stale also consumes this property.
Constraints: Neither stamp alone covers every path: zero-row extraction advances only last_full_run_at, while fast return advances only last_synced_at. Preserve products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/pipelines/pipeline_v3/pipeline.py:PipelineV3._stamp_full_run leaving last_synced_at untouched, because advancing the signals watermark can exclude late-arriving rows from subsequent signals.
proposed.applies: Warehouse schema run-health and stale-status calculations, and changes to timestamp writes on empty extraction or fast-return paths.

proposed.title: Filter stalled schemas in SQL before limiting candidates
answers: Why does a limited stalled-sync sweep miss stopped schemas?
Where should the latest-run filter be applied?
How should malformed or timezone-free run stamps be handled?
proposed.body:
Invariant: Compute and filter by the latest run stamp in SQL before applying the candidate limit; products/warehouse_sources/backend/stalled_schedules.py:stalled_schema_queryset annotates latest_run_at and uses it for stalled_after.
Ordering: products/warehouse_sources/backend/stalled_schedules.py:find_stalled_schemas orders by latest_run_at before slicing and calculates stalled_for from the same annotation.
Failure: Filtering quiet schemas in Python after LIMIT can let them consume every slot; filtering before LIMIT loads every quiet candidate on each sweep.
Cast guard: products/warehouse_sources/backend/stalled_schedules.py:_AWARE_ISO_TIMESTAMP gates the JSON timestamp cast to offset-bearing ISO strings; missing or nonmatching stamps become NULL, allowing PostgreSQL GREATEST to fall back to last_synced_at.
Python counterpart: products/warehouse_sources/backend/models/external_data_schema.py:ExternalDataSchema.last_full_run returns None for parsing failures or naive timestamps; products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/workflow_activities/create_job_model.py:_fast_return_eligible uses that property.
Constraints: Preserve timezone rejection: an unguarded SQL cast can raise on an unparseable string, and PostgreSQL interprets a naive timestamp in the session timezone, inventing freshness.
proposed.applies: Stalled-schema sweep and repair candidate queries, and readers parsing the JSON last_full_run_at stamp.

proposed.title: Use attribute-safe syntax for person-property email merge tags
answers: Why does a person-property merge tag break an email link?
Why does a workflow email send a blank person-property value?
How should the merge-tag menu format property names?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Selecting a person property from the workflow email merge-tag menu can break a link, cause a Liquid parse error, or send a blank property value.
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/email-templater/emailTemplaterLogic.tsx:emailTemplaterLogic emitted double-quoted bracket access; those delimiters terminate double-quoted HTML attributes, and entity-encoded quotes can leave the tag unresolved.
Fix pattern: Use frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/email-templater/emailTemplaterLogic.tsx:buildPersonPropertyMergeValue: names matching /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/ use dot access; other names use single-quoted brackets, escaping backslashes before apostrophes.
Constraints: Applies to person-property tags generated by the email merge-tag menu, including insertion into double-quoted HTML attributes. Preserve literal property names containing spaces, dots, or a leading $ through bracket access. This emission fix does not repair existing pasted tags or change renderer decoding.
proposed.applies: Person-property merge-tag generation in the workflow email templater.

proposed.title: Bound label-reference listings without weakening reference guards
answers: Why does moving or deleting a prompt label produce an enormous error message?
How should label-reference parent listings be capped?
Do capped reference listings still prevent moving or deleting referenced labels?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Moving or deleting a prompt label produces an enormous error body when thousands of prompts reference it.
Root cause: products/ai_observability/backend/prompt_references.py:get_active_parents_referencing_label returned uncapped parent names that were joined into error messages.
Fix pattern: Order distinct parent names in SQL before slicing to MAX_ACTIVE_REFERENCE_RESULTS; this bounds message size and makes the selected names deterministic.
Constraints: The capped listing supports error messages, dialogs, and existence-based guards: references beyond the cap still yield a nonempty result. Do not treat it as a complete reference inventory.
proposed.applies: Active parent-name listings for prompt-label references, especially label-move and label-delete guards and messages.

proposed.title: Evict stale database connections before async Replay Vision activities
answers: Why do observations permanently miss thumbnails after a database connection drops?
Where should async Replay Vision activities clean up stale Django connections?
Why does increasing activity retries fail to recover a dead connection?
proposed.body:
Symptom: An observation can permanently lack a thumbnail after a database connection drops.
Root cause: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/decorators.py:track_activity previously evicted stale connections only before synchronous activities; async ORM work reused a long-lived thread with dead connections.
Fix pattern: In the shared async activity wrapper, await sync_to_async(close_stale_db_connections)() before invoking the activity, so cleanup covers every decorated async activity.
Constraints: Skip eviction under settings.TEST because it touches Django connections in tests without database access. This addresses stale connections; increasing retries alone does not resolve them, and this is not a strategy for multi-minute database outages.
proposed.applies: Async Replay Vision activities wrapped by track_activity, especially activities using Django ORM calls.

proposed.title: Share bounded retries for observation and thumbnail state activities
answers: Which retry policy should Replay Vision state writes use?
Does the thumbnail workflow retry state activities for three minutes?
Where are scan and thumbnail state-write retry limits defined?
proposed.body:
Convention: Observation and media state activities in the scan and thumbnail workflows reuse products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/constants.py:STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY and products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/constants.py:STATE_ACTIVITY_SCHEDULE_TO_CLOSE.
Enforcement: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/workflow.py:ApplyScannerWorkflow and products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/media_workflow.py:ObservationMediaWorkflow pass these constants when scheduling the relevant activities.
Retry semantics: The shared policy allows five attempts, starting with a one-second interval capped at ten seconds; its backoff totals about fifteen seconds (1+2+4+8).
Invariant: The three-minute schedule-to-close timeout bounds the entire retry chain, including backoff, so state-write failure handling fits within the scanner execution timeout. It does not promise three minutes of retries; maximum_attempts can end the chain earlier.
Constraints: Reuse this policy for short PostgreSQL state activities; asset creation, asset ensuring, and thumbnail extraction retain their separate retry policies.
proposed.applies: Scheduling short observation and media state activities in ApplyScannerWorkflow and ObservationMediaWorkflow.

proposed.title: Treat missing thumbnail source assets as non-retryable
answers: Should thumbnail preparation retry when the analysis asset is gone?
Why does thumbnail generation keep retrying a deleted source asset?
How should deterministic thumbnail preparation failures be reported?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Thumbnail preparation retries even though its analysis asset has been deleted and cannot supply a frame.
Root cause: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/activities/observation_media.py:prepare_observation_thumbnail_activity previously let ExportedAsset.DoesNotExist escape from the asset lookup without marking the failure non-retryable.
Fix pattern: Convert deterministic missing-input failures into ApplicationError(non_retryable=True), preserving the original exception as the cause; an absent rendered-object location follows the same non-retryable convention.
Constraints: The lookup remains scoped by analysis_asset_id and team_id. An empty content location is terminal because the analysis render has already finished; this classification does not apply to transient database failures.
proposed.applies: Analysis asset lookup and rendered-object validation during observation thumbnail preparation.

proposed.title: Allow read-only workflow audience POSTs by exact action
answers: Why does the workflow audience count never load during read-only impersonation?
Why does audience sizing return 403 impersonation_read_only?
How should a read-only POST bypass impersonation middleware?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Support staff impersonating in read-only mode cannot load a workflow audience count; sizing returns 403 impersonation_read_only.
Root cause: posthog/middleware.py:ImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware rejects non-idempotent requests before endpoint permissions run; audience sizing uses POST because its filters are too large for a query string.
Fix pattern: Add a method-and-exact-action exception in posthog/middleware.py:READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS after establishing that the action only reads; the workflow audience regex accepts projects/environments, numeric IDs/@current, and an optional trailing slash.
Constraints: Never allow the whole hog_flows/ prefix: it also contains writing actions. Audience sizing may return a confirmation token, but run and batch_jobs must remain blocked so read-only impersonation cannot dispatch a send.
proposed.applies: Read-only impersonation failures for workflow audience sizing and narrowly scoped exceptions for read-only POST actions.

proposed.title: Test allowlist exceptions alongside blocked writing siblings
answers: How do I test a read-only impersonation allowlist change?
How do we prevent workflow writes from becoming available while impersonating?
Where are audience-sizing impersonation regressions covered?
proposed.body:
Convention: Extend the existing parameterized cases in posthog/test/test_middleware.py:TestImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware.test_read_only_impersonation_allows_allowlisted_post for permitted POST actions.
Guard: Pair the exception with writing paths in posthog/test/test_middleware.py:TestImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware.test_read_only_impersonation_blocks_mutating_siblings; workflow coverage includes hog_flows/<id>/publish/ and hog_flows/bulk_delete/.
Failure mode: The allowed-action case catches a regex that stops matching audience sizing; the blocked-sibling cases catch a regex widened to permit workflow writes.
proposed.applies: POST exceptions in the read-only impersonation allowlist, especially actions sharing a URL prefix with writes.

proposed.title: Remove processed-timestamp series when partition ownership ends
answers: Why does IngestionAnalyticsSinglePartitionDelayed page for a partition that is not behind?
Why does an ingestion pod still report a partition after a rebalance?
How should processed-timestamp metrics handle revoked partitions?
proposed.body:
Symptom: IngestionAnalyticsSinglePartitionDelayed can page for a partition that is not behind after a rebalance.
Root cause: nodejs/src/ingestion/ingestion-consumer.ts:latestOffsetTimestampGauge retains the former owner's latest_processed_timestamp_ms series; its stale timestamp ages while an idle new owner may export no series.
Fix pattern: Register partition cleanup through KafkaConsumerInterface.connect; nodejs/src/ingestion/ingestion-consumer.ts:IngestionConsumer.onPartitionsRevoked removes each revoked series using topic, partition and groupId, preserving retained partitions' series.
Constraints: Applies to this analytics processed-timestamp gauge. Remove series rather than resetting the whole gauge. A new owner stalled before processing has no series, so this single-partition alert cannot detect that case; all-partitions and stopped-consuming alerts still cover a stalled lane.
proposed.applies: Analytics ingestion partition ownership changes and latest_processed_timestamp_ms metric lifecycle.

proposed.title: The v1 partition-revoke hook does not block unassignment
answers: Can a partition-revoke callback delay Kafka v1 unassignment?
Where do consumers register cleanup after losing partitions?
Why can revoked-partition cleanup still be running after a Kafka rebalance?
proposed.body:
nodejs/src/common/kafka/consumer/index.ts:KafkaConsumerInterface.connect exposes an optional async onPartitionsRevoked callback receiving revoked Assignment entries.
nodejs/src/common/kafka/consumer/consumer-v1.ts:KafkaConsumer.connect stores that callback; KafkaConsumer invokes it after unassigning partitions and resetting rebalance coordination, without awaiting completion.
KafkaConsumer catches callback failures and logs partition_revoked_handler_failed; preserve this error handling when changing hook dispatch.
Cleanup using this interface must account for implementation timing: the description specifies that v2 awaits the hook before unassignment, while v1 does not. Do not rely on the shared interface to guarantee either ordering.
proposed.applies: Partition-revocation callbacks registered through KafkaConsumerInterface.connect, especially cleanup requiring ordering relative to unassignment.

proposed.title: Use indexed, stable ordering for insight lists without an explicit order
answers: Why is listing insights without an order parameter slow?
What is the default order of the insights API?
How should insight list pagination handle identical modification timestamps?
proposed.body:
Symptom: API clients listing insights without an order parameter wait tens of seconds per page, occupying a web worker throughout each request.
Root cause: products/product_analytics/backend/presentation/insight.py:InsightViewSet.order_queryset previously sorted on the vestigial, nullable, unindexed Insight.order column, forcing repeated project-wide scans and sorts during offset pagination.
Fix pattern: Default to descending last_modified_at, covered by dashboarditem_team_lmod_idx, and descending pk to break timestamp ties deterministically; populated legacy order values must not control this default.
Constraints: Apply this default only when both order and search are absent. Search requests retain their existing queryset ordering, and explicit order parameters retain their own handling. Production index-seek performance was inferred from the index definition, not verified with EXPLAIN.
proposed.applies: Insight API list default ordering and pagination in InsightViewSet.order_queryset.

proposed.title: Use synchronous scene identity to prevent insight editor autosaves
answers: Why does changing chart type save the insight without clicking Save?
Why does the insight editor exit edit mode and show Insight updated?
Which scene state should isInsightSceneInstance compare?
How should persistDisplayOptions handle a stale insightLogicRef?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Selecting a chart type saves the insight without clicking Save, exits edit mode, and shows “Insight updated.”
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightDataLogic.tsx:isInsightSceneInstance previously checked insightLogicRef, which a separate asynchronous listener rebuilds; that ref can lag the editor's current identity and let a PATCH through.
Fix pattern: Determine scene ownership from insightId and dashboardId, updated synchronously by the URL-matching action, so persistDisplayOptions skips the PATCH for the insight currently shown in the editor.
Constraints: isInsightSceneInstance requires the active scene to be Scene.Insight, insightId to match props.dashboardItemId, and dashboardId to match props.dashboardId with null and undefined treated equally. Preserve dashboard context; the editor-instance guard does not apply outside that scene or to a different instance.
proposed.applies: Insight display-option persistence and guards that identify the insight currently open in the editor.

proposed.title: AI detector failure messages must describe the outcome
answers: Why does an AI detector failure say the model provider is unreachable?
What should owners see when an AI detector cannot complete a check?
Should detector failure notifications recommend reviewing alert settings?
proposed.body:
Symptom: An alert owner sees a provider failure and reassurance that their settings are correct even though neither was established.
Root cause: products/alerts/backend/judge/contract.py:LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE represents rollout lookup failures, busy model-call slots, transport failures, and unreadable model replies with one error code.
Fix pattern: Describe the incomplete check without asserting a cause or settings validity; keep posthog/tasks/alerts/utils.py:send_notifications_for_errors and posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:dispatch_alert_error_in_app_notifications aligned with that contract.
Constraints: Apply this wording and omission of settings-review advice to LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_CODE; other evaluation errors retain their separate settings-review behavior.
proposed.applies: Owner-facing check history, email, and in-app messaging for unavailable AI detector checks.

proposed.title: Count detector unavailability only after recording the failed check
answers: Why does one scheduled AI detector check count as several failures?
Where should unavailable detector outcomes be counted?
Should a failed attempt count if a later retry succeeds?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Detector health metrics report several failures for one scheduled check, or both failure and success when a retry succeeds.
Root cause: posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:evaluate_alert is retried by Temporal, so incrementing unavailable there counts attempts instead of recorded outcomes.
Fix pattern: Re-raise unavailable errors for retry; increment unavailable in posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:record_failed_evaluation only after writing the errored check and checking its error code.
Constraints: Count only LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_CODE failures that were actually recorded; skipped writes, including alerts disabled mid-check, and other error types must not increment unavailable.
proposed.applies: The unavailable outcome of posthog_insight_alerts_ai_detector_checks_total across Temporal retries and failure recording.

proposed.title: Revalidate detector type against the prepared worker route
answers: What happens if an alert's detector type changes during a check?
Why would an AI detector run on a worker without model credentials?
How should evaluation handle a detector type that no longer matches its queue?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Changing an alert to an AI detector during a check can send its model call to a worker without model credentials.
Root cause: posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:evaluate_alert reloads the alert after prepare has selected the task queue from the earlier detector type.
Fix pattern: Compare the loaded detector type with inputs.uses_llm_detector before selecting the executor; evaluate the same loaded snapshot only when they agree.
Constraints: On either direction of detector-type mismatch, return no check and no notification, preserve next_check_at, and let the next scheduler tick prepare and route again; only the AI worker holds model credentials.
proposed.applies: Alert evaluation when detector configuration can change between preparation and execution.

proposed.title: Treat zero decimal places as an explicit formatting setting
answers: Why does Decimal places set to 0 still show fractions in a SQL Big number?
How should table formatting distinguish zero decimal places from an unset value?
Should Short style honor a retained decimal places setting?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A SQL insight Big number or table cell displays fractions under style None even when Decimal places is 0.
Root cause: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:formatDataWithSettings and dataVisualizationLogic (tabularData selector) used truthiness checks that skipped zero.
Fix pattern: Check decimalPlaces != null before applying configured rounding; the table selector must bypass this rounding under Short style.
Constraints: Zero is a valid setting. Unset decimal places must preserve full precision in formatDataWithSettings; Short style ignores retained decimal places and uses its own formatting.
proposed.applies: SQL insight numeric display formatting in Big numbers and table cells.

proposed.title: Keep chart series precision until display formatting
answers: Why do metric card totals change when I change Decimal places?
Why are pie totals or breakdown bucket sums wrong?
Where should SQL chart values be rounded?
proposed.body:
Invariant: Configured decimal places must not round numeric series before aggregation; preserve parsed precision, including percent scaling.
Enforcement: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:dataVisualizationLogic (yData selector) and frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/Components/seriesBreakdownLogic.ts:parseBreakdownSeriesValue parse values without decimal-place rounding.
Display boundary: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/Components/Charts/sqlLineGraphAdapter.ts:formatSqlSeriesValue applies display formatting; unstyled values use explicit decimal places or a default cap of 3.
Failure if skipped: Metric totals, averages and change badges, pie totals, and breakdown bucket sums operate on rounded inputs; two 0.49 rows must still aggregate to 0.98 with zero decimal places configured.
Constraints: This applies to numeric chart series and their aggregates; table cell display rounding remains separate.
proposed.applies: SQL chart series parsing, breakdown aggregation, and chart display formatting.

proposed.title: Apply Show nulls as zero after numeric parsing fails
answers: Why does a SQL chart series contain NaN?
Should Show nulls as zero handle the string 'NaN'?
How should unparseable y-axis values be handled?
proposed.body:
Symptom: An unparseable SQL result such as the string 'NaN' becomes NaN in the chart series instead of following Show nulls as zero.
Root cause: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:dataVisualizationLogic (yData selector) checked input values but did not validate the parsed number.
Fix pattern: Check Number.isNaN(parsed) after numeric conversion and return showNullsAsZero ? 0 : null when parsing fails.
Constraints: Apply this fallback to invalid or missing y-axis values; preserve valid numeric precision regardless of configured decimal places.
proposed.applies: SQL insight y-axis numeric parsing and Show nulls as zero behavior.

proposed.title: Workflow cancellation must accept UUIDT invocation IDs
answers: Why does the workflow run Cancel action fail with a validation error?
How should the cancellation API validate invocation_ids?
Can workflow cancellation accept UUIDTs as well as RFC UUIDs?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Cancelling a running workflow from the runs list or by direct API call fails with a validation error, and the run keeps going.
Root cause: nodejs/src/cdp/cdp-api.ts:CdpApi used version-aware UUID validation for invocation_ids, rejecting the UUIDTs issued by the invocation store.
Fix pattern: Validate identifiers against the issuer's format; cancellation uses UUID.validateString(id, false) to accept the 8-4-4-4-12 shape without requiring RFC version or variant bits.
Constraints: Applies to cancellation by invocation_ids. Keep malformed IDs rejected with 400 before calling cancelJobs, whose ::uuid[] bind would otherwise produce a database cast error surfaced as 500; this does not establish validation rules for unrelated UUID fields.
proposed.applies: CDP workflow invocation cancellation using the invocation_ids selector.

proposed.title: Exhausted support draft retries must return a blocked result
answers: Why is a support ticket stuck on Processing?
How should a failed support draft finish?
What must stay in sync when changing draft retries?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A support ticket stays on Processing when the draft agent returns no usable draft or crashes.
Root cause: Raising on the final activity attempt prevents the workflow from recording a result, leaving the ticket in_progress; products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_give_up handles this boundary.
Fix pattern: Raise DraftNotProducedError while retries remain; on the final attempt return an empty reply with confidence 0 and verdict blocked_on_knowledge so the workflow can finish without auto-sending.
Constraints: Applies to missing or failed draft production; successful drafts retain their normal result. The current attempt limit is 2.
Invariant: _give_up and products/conversations/backend/temporal/pipeline.py:SupportReplyWorkflow must use products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/constants.py:DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS together; otherwise fallback timing can disagree with Temporal retry exhaustion.
proposed.applies: Support reply draft activity failures and changes to their Temporal retry policy.

proposed.title: Recover missing draft JSON and select the last valid draft
answers: Why did the support reply use example JSON?
What happens when the draft agent only says it is waiting?
How should support draft agent text be parsed?
proposed.body:
Symptom: A support reply uses an example instead of the final answer, or the agent returns a status sentence without a draft.
Root cause: Agent text can contain example or ticket JSON before the answer, or no usable draft object; products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_parse_draft and _draft_from_session handle these cases.
Fix pattern: Scan JSON objects and validate candidates in reverse order, accepting the last valid draft; if none exists, send one JSON-only follow-up and parse it the same way.
Constraints: A valid first response needs no follow-up. An empty first turn raises before a session is available, so it cannot be nudged; failed or unusable follow-ups go through _give_up.
Timing invariant: _DRAFT_NUDGE_POLL_SECONDS allows two 90-second nudge polls; these and the initial poll must fit within the draft activity's 20-minute timeout in products/conversations/backend/temporal/pipeline.py:SupportReplyWorkflow.
proposed.applies: Parsing and recovering raw agent responses for support reply drafts.

proposed.title: Keep support draft recovery local and omit task output_schema
answers: Why does the support draft call omit output_schema?
Why does draft polling report no agent message?
Where should support-specific draft recovery live?
proposed.body:
Convention: products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_draft_async uses MultiTurnSession.start_raw without output_schema and validates the returned text locally.
Mechanism: The PR description explains that schema-backed output storage completes the task run before an agent message reaches the log, causing polling to fail with no agent message.
Layering: Keep support-specific nudging and fallback handling in products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_draft_from_session and _give_up so other shared-runner callers retain their behavior.
Constraints: This exception applies to the support draft task; the five one-shot model calls retain their JSON schemas.
proposed.applies: Support draft task invocation and placement of its response recovery logic.

proposed.title: Report discovery failures separately from MCP connection success
answers: Why does an MCP server say Connected but show no tools?
How should Desktop handle failed tool discovery after adding a server?
Should no-server and no-connection discovery results show warnings?
proposed.body:
Symptom: An added or connected MCP server shows no tools and gives no explanation when tool listing fails.
Root cause: products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useGatewayServers.ts:useGatewayServers and products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useRegisterGatewayServer.ts:useRegisterGatewayServer previously discarded discovery rejections and successful results skipped as no-server.
Fix pattern: Handle both rejected discovery and skipped === "no-server" with a recovery warning, while preserving the successful connection or registration outcome.
Constraints: Applies to discovery after connecting or registering. Keep "no-connection" quiet because the server's status tag already explains pending OAuth or reauthentication; a successful listing with zero tools is not itself one of these failure conditions.
proposed.applies: Desktop MCP gateway tool discovery after connection or custom-server registration.

proposed.title: Keep MCP discovery warnings independent of upstream error text
answers: What should the warning say when an MCP server cannot list tools?
Can tool discovery toasts display Error.message?
Why use fixed recovery text for an added server with no tools?
proposed.body:
Invariant: Tool-discovery warning toasts must use fixed recovery text rather than the upstream error reason.
Enforcement: products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useGatewayServers.ts:DISCOVERY_FAILED and products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useRegisterGatewayServer.ts:DISCOVERY_FAILED supply context-specific "Connected" or "Added" messages directing the user to open the server and retry.
Failure if skipped: The refresh endpoint's detail can contain fragments of the upstream server's response body, so rendering that reason in a toast can expose upstream content.
proposed.applies: User-facing warnings for failed Desktop MCP gateway tool listing.
